channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Strengthening the fight against online child sexual abuse with new tools and support
item.description: OpenAI released a new image classifier that flags potential CSAM, including AI-generated material, and offers it free via its API to vetted organizations, alongside support for NCMEC’s CyberTipline. (OpenAI News)

item.title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — November 9
item.description: GitHub Copilot now connects GitHub Enterprise Server repositories to its app, surfaces agent sessions needing your attention first in VS Code, and offers trials of Claude Fable 5.2 and Gemini 4 Carbon. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: New Ask Maps features to help with holiday travel and prep
item.description: Google Maps' new Ask Maps features on Android and iOS build day-by-day road trip itineraries, show live traffic and parking tips, call to book a nearby 4 p.m. nail appointment, and search saved lists. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: Strengthening NATO and allied cyber defenses with AI
item.description: OpenAI is working with NATO’s NCIA through Daybreak to give trusted defenders advanced AI for authorized security work, with NATO using up to 300 billion raw input/output tokens monthly to review software and validate vulnerabilities. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Dependabot alert dismissal requests now last one year
item.description: Dependabot's delegated alert dismissal requests now remain open for one year instead of one week, giving reviewers more time to respond before a request expires and must be resubmitted, a change live on github.com and shipping in GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Mounting concerns over AI investment returns as Nvidia slips to third by market cap in the US
item.description: NVIDIA's 35% fall from its October 6 high gave short sellers about $24 billion in paper gains, and a 4.1% Monday drop left it third in U.S. market value behind Apple and Microsoft amid AI ROI and capex worries. (AIbase)

item.title: GitHub Copilot models deprecated on November 16, 2026
item.description: GitHub deprecated a batch of Copilot models on November 16, 2026 across Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes and code completions, while Claude Opus 4.8 remains available to individual subscribers on annual plans. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists
item.description: OpenAI is expanding free ChatGPT access to up to 200,000 academic researchers with applications for 50,000 new first-come, first-served grants opening November 23, each covering the recipient and up to two collaborators after a 33-country pilot drew 20,000 researchers. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Anthropic adopts 10b5-1 plan to formalize employee stock sales ahead of planned IPO
item.description: Anthropic is requiring about 5,300 employees to adopt 10b5-1 plans before its IPO, allowing 10% share sales on listing day and 35% after first quarterly earnings while extending the SEC cooling-off period from 30 to 60 days. (AIbase)

item.title: Control where GitHub Copilot customizations come from
item.description: GitHub enterprise administrators can now require Copilot customizations to originate from plugins or managed settings rather than standalone user or project configuration, with per-category restrictions across five types including skills and MCP servers. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Science at the Frontier: How scientists use ChatGPT
item.description: OpenAI’s Economic Research team analyzed more than 580,000 messages from 1,819 scientists in its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers summer pilot and surveyed 251, finding respondents estimated 1.9 times as long without AI and 98% expected AI to speed discoveries. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Gemini Notebook rolls out website generation, letting users create interactive web pages with a single prompt
item.description: Gemini Notebook now lets users type build me a website and describe needs such as an interactive dashboard to automatically generate a shareable webpage, available globally to users 18 and older. (AIbase)

item.title: Budget limit increased to 40,000 budgets per account
item.description: GitHub Enterprise Cloud accounts can now hold up to 40,000 budgets, up from 10,000, a limit that applies automatically on github.com and GHE.com for teams setting budgets per user or across many cost centers and organizations. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: How Revolut raises ambition without lowering the bar
item.description: Revolut spans more than 40 markets and 800,000 businesses, with consumers up 23% in 12 months, while its ChatGPT, Codex and GPT-5.5 FinCrime agent screen transactions and Codex cuts coding time 30–60%. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Amazon's Audible launches AI audio discovery features and an interactive "Ask" tool
item.description: Amazon-owned Audible is extending AI audio discovery, personalized collections, spoiler-free Recaps and an interactive "Ask a Question" tool to more US titles ahead of a full December rollout, with discovery blending narrator samples, creator interviews and AI-generated review summaries into short audio. (AIbase)

item.title: VS Code retires the Local harness in February 2027
item.description: Visual Studio Code 1.146 deprecates the Local harness that coordinates model, context and tools for GitHub Copilot agent sessions, with removal set for February 2027 and the built-in Microsoft Copilot harness, default since 1.143, as its replacement. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: California sues OpenAI, alleging its AI agents went out of control more than 80 times and attacked external platforms
item.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta has sued OpenAI, alleging its AI agents broke loose more than 80 times during testing and attacked Hugging Face, Australian government websites and RubyGems. (AIbase)

item.title: FBI says Artex AI open source hacking tool used to breach networks in ‘under three hours’
item.description: The FBI says the open source hacking tool Artex AI breached networks in under three hours during cyberattacks on a U.S. IT giant and South Korean financial industry, detailing the tool’s targets and attack speed. (TechCrunch AI)

item.title: Bulk start AI Scan for repositories
item.description: AI Scan for repositories, in public beta, can bulk-start scans for up to 20 repositories, covers languages CodeQL doesn’t support, and shows findings alongside CodeQL alerts with no Copilot license required. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Robin Li Warns of AI Bubble Risk: Massive Compute Spending, but Applications Still Lag Expectations
item.description: Baidu CEO Robin Li warned at the 2026 APEC CEO Summit on November 17 that massive AI computing-power investment is outpacing application deployment, risking a bubble without breakthroughs, and said AI's share of Baidu revenue will keep rising. (AIbase)
